items.t: Timing belt pulley or tensioner failure ruins the engine
items.job: Replace timing belt, idler and tensioner pulleys and water pump
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $1,400-$1,600 for the timing belt alone; doing the water pump at the same time saves labor. If the belt already failed, owners report engine repair or replacement costs of $4,000-$9,500.

items.t: Stalls while driving and won't restart (crankshaft sensor)
Coolant leak at the engine oil cooler
items.job: Replace engine oil cooler or its seals and flush fluids
items.note: RepairPal lists engine oil cooler replacement at about $970-$1,160.

items.t: Coolant loss and overheating
items.job: Pressure test cooling system and replace thermostat
items.note: RepairPal lists Catera thermostat replacement at about $680-$800. A water pump runs about $740-$770 from YourMechanic; head gasket work costs far more.

items.t: Temperature gauge reads hot when the engine is not overheating
Automatic transmission slipping or shifting badly
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with rebuilt unit
items.note: One owner reported about $3,000 for a replacement transmission.

items.t: Crankshaft pulley (harmonic balancer) separates
Check engine light from a cracked air injection hose
Oil leaks from the valve cover and timing cover
items.note: RepairPal lists valve cover gasket replacement at about $240-$340; one YourMechanic quote was about $930.

items.t: Heater control valve leaks coolant
Hesitation or rough running fixed by a computer update
Car pulls right and wears the front tires
Heated seat overheats and burns the seat
Headlight aim adjusters break and lenses yellow
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $700 on average; owners on the Center for Auto Safety site cite $340-$500 per light.

items.t: ABS and traction control warning lights
items.job: Diagnose ABS and replace wheel speed sensor

items.t: Airbag warning light stays on
items.job: Diagnose airbag system and repair connector or module

items.t: Climate control display goes blank
Radio static from the rear window defogger
Water leaks into the cabin
items.job: Clear drains and reseal leak points

items.t: Door locks and keyless entry act up
items.note: YourMechanic quoted about $440 for a rear door lock actuator.

items.t: Rear brake squeal
